channel.title: West Hawaii Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Polar plunge persists in the Northeast as low-temperature records are set
item.description: Much of the eastern United States has felt like a meat locker since mid-January, particularly in the Northeast, where temperatures have been as much as 30 degrees below normal.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie, in new video message, promises to pay for return of her mother
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. — In a subdued and cryptic new video shared on social media Saturday evening, the children of Nancy Guthrie again addressed her purported kidnapper, pleading for the return of their mother and promising to pay for her release.

item.title: Washington Post CEO Will Lewis steps down after stormy tenure
item.description: Will Lewis, the embattled CEO and publisher of The Washington Post, has stepped down, the company announced Saturday, days after the newspaper came under widespread criticism for laying off hundreds of its journalists.

item.title: Bills aimed at legalizing recreational marijuana lack support
item.description: Two bills aimed at legalizing recreational marijuana — or even creating marijuana guardrails — are effectively dead, according to House Speaker Nadine Nakamura and Rep. David Tarnas, who has pushed for legalization for years.

item.title: Global tourism rivals start to gain ground amid flat growth
item.description: Hawaii entered 2026 with a visitor industry still well below its prepandemic peak, and new forecasts point to another year of modest gains as Maui’s recovery drags and international markets — especially Japan and Canada — continue to lag.

item.title: Isles brace for storm: County, state announce school and facilities closures
item.description: The state and county have announced closures for today due to the severe weather.

item.title: Long-vacant state jobs targeted by lawmakers
item.description: The number of stagnant state job vacancies tying up taxpayer revenue jumped last year after flattening in 2024, expanding a pile of cash that some Hawaii lawmakers want to use for urgent needs amid looming budget uncertainties.

item.title: War came to Ukraine and its dogs are not the same
item.description: The human cost of the war in Ukraine has been well documented. But Russia’s invasion is also affecting the country’s pets in surprising ways.

item.title: Seahawks ride defense, Kenneth Walker to Super Bowl LX victory
item.description: SANTA CLARA, Calif. — Kenneth Walker III rushed for 135 yards and Seattle’s top-ranked scoring defense scored the decisive blow in a 29-13 win over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX at Levi’s Stadium on Sunday.
